basics.name: Steve Forsyth
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Architect
basics.summary:
With over 18 years of experience as CEO and Principal Consultant, I specialize in custom application architecture and database system development, delivering tailored solutions to meet client-specific business scaling needs. My work spans collaborations with prominent clients, including Cengage Learning, Zappos, Leapfrog, and Harrah's Casino, where I provided expert technical guidance and end-to-end development services.

Recent projects include work on birdcart.com, a product aggregator leveraging Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, OpenAI, Gemini and Elastic Search, and The Civic Fix (coming soon), a government solution platform developed in React and hosted on Google Cloud Run and Neon. My work reflects a commitment to high-quality, scalable, and innovative technical solutions that drive business success.

work.name: iTraker, Inc.
work.summary: Strategic technical consulting and high-level strategy for diverse clients.
highlights: Serve as the principal technical lead for diverse clients, providing high-level strategy in application architecture and database development.
Direct end-to-end development of custom applications and database systems tailored to specific business scaling needs.
Clients include Cengage Learning, Zappos, Leapfrog and Harrahs Casino
**More recent work**

birdcart.com is a product aggregator linking product shopping carts with content creators such as figurine painting. Backend built in Spring Boot/Spring Data/JPA/Security. Aggregates data using Youtube API, Shopify GraphQL Storefront and Admin APIs, OpenAI API, Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL

thecivicfix.com (coming soon) is a government solution aggregator built in React.js using Google Gemini. Runs in Google Cloud Run and Neon (PostgreSQL) provisioned by Terraform and deployed via GitHub Actions using Docker

**Technologies used:** Java, Spring Boot/Spring Data/JPA/REST, Apache Camel, Apache Karaf, Apache Cassandra, Apache ActiveMQ, Apache Wicket, PostgreSQL, Oracle DB, MS Sql Server, Boomi, Elasticsearch, GIT, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Docker, GCP, React.js, GraphQL, OpenAI API, Youtube API

work.name: Zeitview
work.summary: Development, architecture and mentoring in a fully remote, Java role working on a drone based renewables inspection platform.
highlights: Orchestrated a company-wide initiative to architect the consolidation of multiple acquired platforms into a unified legacy system, modernizing UI and services while maintaining database integrity.
Engineered a high-performance, two-way integration engine using Spring Boot, Hibernate, S3, PostgreSQL, and ActiveMQ to facilitate real-time inspection data flow.
Optimized legacy code refactoring and parsing by leveraging GitHub Copilot, significantly accelerating development turnaround.
Provided technical mentorship and architectural guidance in a fully remote environment to ensure scalable system design.
Agile development practices with 2 week sprints, sprint reviews and retrospectives
Restful services using OpenAPI/Swagger to facilitate rapid UI integrations

**Technologies used:** Java, Spring Boot/Spring Data/REST, Hibernate, Apache Camel, Apache ActiveMQ, S3, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, GIT, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD, SonarCube, React.js, OpenAPI, Swagger, Graphana

work.name: Cengage Learning
work.summary: Architecting online higher education applications and enterprise integrations.

Built a sophisticated SOA service layer featuring a multi-threaded course processor that allowed educators to customize content via real-time narrative edits.
Designed an Apache Wicket-based application enabling developers to build custom queries against Cassandra and Elastic Search engines.

**Technologies used:** Java, Spring Boot, Apache Karaf, Apache Camel, Apache CXF, Apache Wicket, Hibernate, Apache Cassandra, Apache ActiveMQ, Elastic, Boomi, Oracle DB, MS Sql Server, Postgres, GIT
